text_blocks.snippet: The AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine, also known as AZD1222 or Vaxzevria, is a viral vector vaccine developed by the University of Oxford and AstraZeneca. It was one of the first vaccines to be approved for use against COVID-19 during the pandemic.

list.snippet: Target virus: SARS-CoV-2 (virus that causes COVID-19)

Mechanism: Uses a weakened adenovirus (common cold virus) as a vector to deliver the genetic code for the spike protein of the SARS-CoV-2 virus into the body. This allows the body to produce the spike protein and develop immunity against it.
